subject: Marine Works - Diving - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Diving - Vancouver Harbour
Diving operations will take place in Second Narrows at 49 17.650N 123 01.150W.
Hours of operation from 2330 UTC 15 Nov to 0730 UTC 17 Nov.
Hydra 3 on site monitoring VHF channel 69.
Mariners are asked to remain 100m clear of dive vessel.
Minimum wake.
